R0.candidate_unit: raw dense top-20 -> current production hygiene -> raw-vector fallback order -> final top-8

R1.candidate_unit: raw dense top-20 -> current production hygiene -> frozen P1A hygiene -> raw-vector fallback order -> final top-8

raw_pool_k20.note: K=20 is reported only for the raw candidate pool; it is not a final review result because CURRENT_FINAL_K=8.

required_depth_diagnostic.description: Maximum original dense rank needed by the frozen P1A projected Top-K rows across the inspected development-validation cases; diagnostic only.

production_retrieval_shape.filtering_order: raw vector candidate truncation -> current hygiene -> rerank/fallback -> final review projection
production_retrieval_shape.rerank_contract: 4.3-role-need-rerank-v1; frozen Eval inputs lack approved semantic metadata, so raw-vector fallback is used
production_retrieval_shape.distinction: POST_TRUNCATION_HYGIENE is the current behavior; BOUNDED_OVERFETCH_THEN_HYGIENE is not implemented or silently simulated.

metric_definitions.evidence_atom_recall: Frozen Gold atoms with at least one accepted span; Top-K candidate identity match covers atom.
metric_definitions.candidate_precision: Top-K candidates with frozen Gold grade >= 2 divided by requested K; denominator remains requested K when final pool is short.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of first frozen Gold grade >= 2 candidate in the returned final ranking; null when absent.
metric_definitions.ndcg: Frozen Gold item grades only, standard gain (2^grade-1) and log2 discount.
metric_definitions.k0: Expected retrieval K0 is derived from frozen Gold evidence items all having grade < 2; false positive/negative rates are reported separately.

stop_conditions: Do not promote P1A to production.
Do not convert observed depth into candidateK, overfetchK, reviewK, or runtime threshold.
Do not implement full-ranking retrieval or unbounded overfetch.
Do not start P2, P3, P4, MMR, hybrid, or reranker.
Do not treat retrieved candidates as supported evidence or claim authorization.
